preserve_wrapper.tooltip: When enabled, will delegate to an existing model function wrapper if it exists. Generally should be left enabled.

start_sigma.tooltip: First sigma that these options will be in effect.

end_sigma.tooltip: Last sigma that these options will be in effect.

nerf_tile_size.tooltip: Allows overriding the default NeRF tile size. -1 means use the default (32). 0 means use non-tiling mode (may require a lot of VRAM).

force_sequential_txt_ids.tooltip: Force usage of sequential text token IDs instead of zeroes. Should be used for checkpoints from 2026-05-22 to 2026-06-01 that are trained in this way but do not contain the __sequential__ key in the state dict.

layers.tooltip: Layer stack to composite; build it with Add Layer. Items are stacked by z_index, batch frames inside an item expand to consecutive layers, and item placement, opacity, and blend mode define the initial composition. Without an explicit document canvas the size is a best-effort maximum extent of the placed layers. A saved composition that matches the current inputs takes priority.

compositor.tooltip: Layered composition saved by the compositor editor.

image.tooltip: Layer content at its native size. A batch expands to consecutive layers.

layers.tooltip: Layer stack to append to. Leave unconnected to start a new stack.

mask.tooltip: Transparency mask for this layer. Masked areas (value 1) become transparent, multiplying with any alpha channel the image already carries.

name.tooltip: Layer name shown in the compositor editor.

x.tooltip: Initial horizontal placement on the canvas.

y.tooltip: Initial vertical placement on the canvas.

blend_mode.tooltip: Initial blend mode, applied against the layers below. On the bottom layer over the default transparent background, non-normal modes produce transparency.

width.tooltip: Initial display width. 0 keeps the image's native width.

height.tooltip: Initial display height. 0 keeps the image's native height.

z_index.tooltip: Stacking override. Layers are stable-sorted by z_index; equal values keep their list order.

image.tooltip: Image batch; each frame becomes one layer.

bboxes.tooltip: Placement boxes, index-aligned with the image batch. Accepts bounding boxes (x, y, width, height), normalized elements (with a 'bbox' - these need canvas_width/canvas_height to resolve to pixels), or a JSON string of either. Frames without a matching box are placed at the origin. A box's width/height scales the layer to fit it. metadata.name (or desc) and metadata.z_index are used when present, and metadata.content_rect (frame-relative) crops the frame to its real content.

mask.tooltip: Per-frame transparency, index-aligned with the image batch (1 = transparent, LoadImage convention).

layers.tooltip: Layer stack to append to. Leave unconnected to start a new stack.

crop_to_content.tooltip: Crop each frame to metadata.content_rect where present and place the content at the box position plus the rect offset. Leave on for batches whose frames are padded - it keeps only the real content at its true spot.

canvas_width.tooltip: Document canvas width. 0 derives it from the placed layers.

canvas_height.tooltip: Document canvas height. 0 derives it from the placed layers.

frames.tooltip: -1, 0, 1 = single still image; >1 = turntable, the camera orbits over a full 360 turn (works with any camera_info). Negative value orbits the other way.

splat_scale.tooltip: Multiplier on each splat's projected footprint (lower = crisper points, higher = softer/fuller surface).

sharpen.tooltip: Sharpen overlapping splats: 1.0 = physically-correct blend; higher biases each pixel toward its dominant (nearest) splat for crisper texture, without shrinking splats or opening gaps. Non-physical above 1.

headlight_shading.tooltip: Diffuse shading from a light at the camera (headlight), using the splat surfel normals: darkens surfaces that turn away from view to reveal form/curvature. 0 = flat albedo, 1 = strongest shading.

opacity_threshold.tooltip: Cull gaussians with opacity below this (removes faint floaters).

render_style.tooltip: What the image output shows: color, clay (neutral-albedo shaded), depth (near=bright), normal (OpenGL normal map).

bg_image.tooltip: Optional background plate composited behind the splat (overrides the solid background colour). Resized to the render size; a batch is used per frame, a single image for all. color/clay only.

camera_info.tooltip: Camera to render from - a Load3D / Preview3D camera or a Create Camera Info node. If empty, the splat is auto-framed from a default 3/4 view.

quat_w.tooltip: Camera world-rotation quaternion (three.js: looks down local -Z). Normalized for you.

target_x.tooltip: Look-at point (orbit pivot / aim). In orbit mode, move it to pan/translate the whole camera. Ignored in quaternion mode. Defaults to the origin.

roll.tooltip: Camera roll about the view axis, degrees.

fov.tooltip: Vertical field of view in degrees.

zoom.tooltip: Digital zoom (focal-length multiplier). >1 zooms in without moving the camera.

camera_type.tooltip: Projection used by Render Splat: perspective (foreshortening) or orthographic (parallel).

resolution.tooltip: Density-grid resolution along the longest axis. Higher = finer surface, more VRAM/time (grows with resolution^3).

kernel.tooltip: Max splat half-width in voxels. Each gaussian is rasterized over a window sized to its own 3-sigma, capped here - small surfels stay cheap, large ones aren't truncated. Raise if sparse splats leave gaps.

smooth.tooltip: Taubin mesh-smoothing iterations. Smooths the surface without shrinking it (volume-preserving), unlike blurring the density. 0 = raw surface.

level.tooltip: Iso-surface level. Auto-picked by Otsu; this biases it (1.0 = auto, lower = fatter/more-connected surface, higher = thinner/tighter).

min_component.tooltip: Drop connected components smaller than this many vertices (0 = keep all). Removes detached floater blobs and the inner shell of the double wall.

min_opacity.tooltip: Ignore gaussians fainter than this before meshing.

color_sharpen.tooltip: Crisp up the vertex texture: 1.0 = physically-correct blend; higher biases each voxel's colour toward its dominant gaussian instead of averaging neighbours (de-smears the texture). Colour only - geometry is unchanged.

fragment_shader.tooltip: GLSL fragment shader source code (GLSL ES 3.00 / WebGL 2.0 compatible)

size_mode.tooltip: Output size: 'from_input' uses first input image dimensions, 'custom' allows manual size

floats.tooltip: Floats are available as u_float0-19 in the shader code

ints.tooltip: Ints are available as u_int0-19 in the shader code

end_percent.tooltip: Sampling progress at which the blend turns OFF.

pattern.tooltip: Shift layout. single_shift: one pass at the natural patch grid + others offset. symmetric: all passes off-grid, shifts split around origin.

passes.tooltip: Number of passes per gated step. 2/4 = fixed. ramp_*: pass count increases as sampling approaches end (more smoothing where seams are most visible).

blend.tooltip: average: equal-weight mean. window: Hann-windowed weighting favoring each pass away from its patch boundaries. median: per-pixel median, rejects wraparound-outlier passes.

strength.tooltip: Interpolation between the natural-grid pred (0) and the averaged result (1).

image_interleave.tooltip: How much the image influences things vs the text prompt. Higher number means more influence from the text prompt.

img_compression.tooltip: Amount of compression to apply on image.

reference_audio.tooltip: Reference audio clip whose speaker identity to transfer. ~5 seconds recommended (training duration). Shorter or longer clips may degrade voice identity transfer.

identity_guidance_scale.tooltip: Strength of identity guidance. Runs an extra forward pass without reference each step to amplify speaker identity. Set to 0 to disable (no extra pass).

start_percent.tooltip: Start of the sigma range where identity guidance is active.

end_percent.tooltip: End of the sigma range where identity guidance is active.

blocks.tooltip: Comma-separated transformer block indices to perturb.

duration_head.tooltip: LTX 2.4 duration head loaded with ModelPatchLoader.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model to use for encoding.
The Audio VAE model used for decoding the latent.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent audio samples in the batch.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model to get configuration from.

positive.tooltip: Positive conditioning the keyframes are attached to.

negative.tooltip: Negative conditioning the keyframes are attached to.

vae.tooltip: Only used to read the latent scale factors.

latent.tooltip: Plain 5D video latent to generate keyframes alongside. Add them before Concat AV Latent.

interval_frames.tooltip: Pixel-frame stride for auto placement. Default 24 is about one keyframe per second at 24 fps. Occupied pixels are skipped. Ignored when frame_indices is set.

keyframes.tooltip: Optional content to initialize the new keyframes with. Connect keyframes from an earlier Separate (same spatial size), or a plain video latent to copy the nearest frame at each new slot (e.g. after temporal upscale). These are still denoised, not pinned as guides. Recorded indices on a keyframes latent are ignored unless frame_indices is set. Only has an effect when sampling starts below sigma 1.

frame_indices.tooltip: Optional pixel-frame indices. Leave empty to place from interval_frames on the current canvas. When set, this list is the placement (connected keyframes are matched in order). The last frame is allowed; frame 0 is not (it is already a standalone token).

keyframes_to_batch.tooltip: Return the keyframes as a batch of single-frame latents. Leave off to get them as one multi-frame latent, which is what the latent upsampler and a later Add Generated Keyframes expect.

latent.tooltip: The target video latent to add the guides to, e.g. the temporally upscaled one.

keyframes.tooltip: The keyframes output of LTXV Separate Generated Keyframes, which carries the pixel frame index each keyframe was generated at.

strength.tooltip: Guide strength. 1.0 is a hard pin; lower values relax it.

override_frame_indices.tooltip: Optional — pin at these pixel frames instead of the recorded (or auto-scaled) positions. Provide one index per keyframe. Leave empty to reuse recorded positions, or to scale them when the target canvas is a different length (e.g. after temporal x2).

latent.tooltip: Video or audio latent to freeze. Audio is 4D; video is 5D.

system_prompt.tooltip: Lumina2 provide two types of system prompts:Superior: You are an assistant designed to generate superior images with the superior degree of image-text alignment based on textual prompts or user prompts. Alignment: You are an assistant designed to generate high-quality images with the highest degree of image-text alignment based on textual prompts.

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.

images.tooltip: Reference image(s) to edit. All references are resized to the output resolution before encoding.

width.tooltip: Output width. 0 = use the first reference image's size.

height.tooltip: Output height. 0 = use the first reference image's size.

detector_variant.tooltip: Face detector range. 'short' is tuned for close-up faces (within ~2 m of the camera); 'full' covers farther / smaller faces (up to ~5 m) but is slower. 'both' runs both detectors and keeps whichever found more faces per frame (~2× detection cost).

num_faces.tooltip: Maximum faces to return per frame. 0 = no cap (return all detected).

min_confidence.tooltip: BlazeFace score threshold. Lower to catch small/occluded faces.

missing_frame_fallback.tooltip: Per-frame behaviour when detection fails in a batch. 'empty' leaves the frame faceless. 'previous' copies the most recent successful detection. 'interpolate' lerps landmarks/bbox/blendshapes between bracketing successful frames. Multi-face: pairs faces across frames by greedy bbox-centre NN.

connections.tooltip: 'all' = oval+eyes+brows+lips+irises+nose. 'fill' = solid face_oval polygon (silhouette mask). 'custom' = toggle each feature individually (including 'tesselation', the full 2547-edge wireframe).

thickness.tooltip: Edge line thickness in pixels. 0 disables edge drawing.

point_size.tooltip: Landmark dot radius in pixels. 0 disables point drawing.

image.tooltip: If not connected, a black canvas will be used.

regions.tooltip: 'all' = union of face_oval+lips+eyes+irises (which collapses to face_oval since it encloses the rest). 'custom' = toggle each region individually for combos like lips+eyes.

face_oval.tooltip: Include the 'face_oval' region in the mask.

lips.tooltip: Include the 'lips' region in the mask.

left_eye.tooltip: Include the 'left_eye' region in the mask.

right_eye.tooltip: Include the 'right_eye' region in the mask.

irises.tooltip: Include the 'irises' region in the mask.

model_3d.tooltip: 3D model file from Load 3D or another 3D node. FBX/USDZ are not supported - convert to GLB first.

max_perimeter.tooltip: Max hole perimeter to fill. 0 disables.

weld_epsilon_rel.tooltip: Pre-weld tolerance (fraction of bounding box diagonal); boundary detection needs welded vertices. 0 skips.

max_vertices.tooltip: Cap boundary vertices per cycle; centroid-fan only works for small near-planar holes. Keep ≤16.

fill_chains.tooltip: Also fill open chains (not just cycles). Noisy; OFF matches cumesh.

epsilon_rel.tooltip: Weld tolerance (fraction of bbox diagonal). 1e-5 for float dedup; 1e-3 for visibly-close-but-distinct verts.

line_quadric_weight.tooltip: Per-edge line-quadric weight; preserves sharp ridges/valleys. 0 = off.

feature_edge_quadric_weight.tooltip: Extra quadric weight on dihedral feature edges (creases). 0 = off.

feature_edge_min_dihedral_deg.tooltip: Minimum dihedral angle (degree) to count an edge as a feature edge.

clamp_v_to_edge.tooltip: Project the QEM-optimal position onto the collapsed edge segment.

resolution.tooltip: Voxel grid resolution (output density). 256 ~ 100k faces, 512 ~ 1M. For an exact face count, follow with Decimate Mesh.

sign_mode.tooltip: udf: robust to messy/non-manifold input. sdf: clean single surface with QEF (Quadratic Error Function) sharp-feature recovery, but needs consistent winding.

qef.tooltip: QEF (Quadratic Error Function) dual-vertex placement for sharper edges.

drop_inverted_components.tooltip: Drop inward-normal (negative-volume) closed components — the UDF inner shell.

drop_enclosed_components.tooltip: Drop components inside the largest's bbox that fail a point-in-mesh raycast. Disable for legitimate nested parts.

qef.tooltip: QEF (Quadratic Error Function) dual-vertex placement (recovers sharp features) vs edge-crossing centroid.

manifold.tooltip: Manifold Dual Contouring: 1-4 dual verts/voxel for multi-sheet cases. Slower.

band.tooltip: Narrow-band width in voxel units. In UDF mode also offsets the surface.

project_back.tooltip: Linearly interpolate vertices toward the original surface (0 = pure DC, 1 = snapped).

fix_poles.tooltip: Collapse valence-3 vertex pairs (DC T-junction artifact).

smooth_iters.tooltip: Taubin smoothing iterations (0 = off). 2-3 cleans DC staircase-like artifacts; higher over-smooth QEF edges.

drop_small_components.tooltip: Drop components below this fraction of the largest's face count. 0 disables.

precluster_max_verts.tooltip: Cap input vertex count before the field queries, inputs above this are cluster-decimated to it first. Prevents OOM on huge meshes.

segmenter.tooltip: pec: fast parallel-edge-collapse charting on GPU. adaptive: CPU, slower.

resolution.tooltip: Target atlas resolution for texel-density auto-scale (0 = fit-to-content).

weld_distance.tooltip: Coincident-vert merge radius as a fraction of mesh extent (0 = auto). Raise to ~0.001 if you get per-triangle charts (unwelded input).

reference_mesh.tooltip: Optional dense pre-decimation mesh; back-projects each texel onto its true surface before sampling, removing faceted baking on coarse meshes.

cage_distance.tooltip: Surface search band, as a fraction of the bounding box diagonal. Raise for wrong/missing patches under heavy decimation; lower if it grabs across gaps.

ignore_backfaces.tooltip: Skip high-poly surfaces facing away from the texel, so crevices/enclosed spaces don't grab the opposite wall. Disable only if the high-poly winding is inconsistent.

samples.tooltip: Rays per texel. More = smoother, slower. Raise if grainy.

max_distance.tooltip: Ray length, as a fraction of the bounding box diagonal. Smaller = tighter, more local occlusion.

bias.tooltip: Ray origin lift off the surface, as a fraction of the bounding box diagonal. Raise if even surfaces show dark blotches/holes.

mode.tooltip: What to render. auto: texture if present, else vertex colours, else shaded clay.

model_3d_info.tooltip: Model transform from the same Load3D / Preview3D viewer. Connect it with camera_info to match the viewer framing.

camera_info.tooltip: Camera from a Load3D / Preview3D viewer or a Create Camera Info node. If none is connected, a default front view is auto-framed.

crease_angle.tooltip: Edges whose dihedral angle exceeds this value (degrees) stay hard (vertices are split). 180 = fully smooth; lower preserves sharp edges (e.g. ~30-60 for hard-surface).

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, snapped up to the model's 17k+5 grid (124 = ~5s; trained range is ~124-362, longer is untested)
Frame count at 24 fps, snapped up to the model's 17k+5 grid (124 = ~5s; trained range is ~124-362, longer is untested)

frame_idx.tooltip: Frame index to anchor the image or the clip's first frame at. Negative values are counted from the end of the video.

vae.tooltip: Video VAE, needed when an image is connected.

audio_vae.tooltip: Audio VAE, needed when an audio is connected.

image.tooltip: Image or video frames to anchor. Multi-frame batches are anchored as a clip and cropped down to the model's valid clip lengths: 5, 22, 39... (17k + 5) frames. Batches shorter than 5 frames use only the first image.

audio.tooltip: Soundtrack to anchor starting at the same frame index, cropped to the video's remaining duration.

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, (124 = ~5s, trained range is ~124-362)

ref_image_size.tooltip: Reference image sizing. 'match' scales each ref (down only, keeping aspect) to the generation's pixel area; 'max' uses the reference pipeline's 2048px short edge for best identity fidelity. Reference tokens ride through every sampling step, so 'max' can be several times slower.

vae.tooltip: Video VAE. Without it reference images/videos only condition the text encoder.

audio_vae.tooltip: Audio VAE. Without it reference audio only conditions the text encoder.

ref_image.tooltip: Reference image (downscaled to 2048 short edge if larger, never upscaled)

ref_video_audio.tooltip: Soundtrack of the same-numbered reference video

source_video.tooltip: Video behind the mask; only read when a mask is given.

max_duration.tooltip: Maximum duration in seconds; the model can end the song earlier.

noise_scale.tooltip: Absolute training noise scale. For example HiDream-O1 base: 8.0, dev: 7.5.

attention.tooltip: The dense attention backend. Comfy Kitchen attention uses quantized INT8 attention and is available only on Nvidia and AMD GPUs.

render_video.tooltip: The guidance video rendered from the camera trajectory, most commonly warped point cloud renders of the input image.

strength_start.tooltip: Control strength at the start of sampling (high sigma).

strength_end.tooltip: Control strength at the end of sampling (low sigma). Linearly interpolated from start.

restore_cfg.tooltip: Pulls denoised output toward the input latent. Higher = stronger fidelity to input. 0 to disable.

restore_cfg_s_tmin.tooltip: Sigma threshold below which restore_cfg is disabled.

fov_x_degrees.tooltip: Horizontal field of view of the source camera. Sets the focal length used to unproject the depth map into 3D. 0 = auto-recover from the predicted points.

batch_size.tooltip: Images per inference call. Lower if you OOM on a long video / image set.

apply_mask.tooltip: Set masked-out (sky / invalid) pixels to inf in points and depth so meshing culls them. Disable to keep the raw predicted geometry everywhere; the mask is still returned separately.

merge_resolution.tooltip: Long-side resolution of the merged equirect distance map.

batch_size.tooltip: Views per inference batch (12 splits total).

output.tooltip: DirectX vs OpenGL controls the normal-map green-channel convention. DirectX: green = -Y down (Unreal). OpenGL: green = +Y up (Blender, Substance, Unity, glTF).

batch_index.tooltip: Which image of a batched MoGe geometry to mesh. Per-image vertex counts differ, so batches can't be stacked into a single MESH.

discontinuity_threshold.tooltip: Drop pixels whose 3x3 depth span exceeds this fraction. 0 = off.

texture.tooltip: Carry the source image through as the baseColor texture.

MoGePointMapToMesh.name: MoGePointMapToMesh
MoGePointMapToMesh.display_name: Convert MoGe Point Map to Mesh

model.tooltip: The model to apply NAG to.

nag_scale.tooltip: The guidance scale factor. Higher values push further from the negative prompt.

nag_alpha.tooltip: Blending factor for the normalized attention. 1.0 is full replacement, 0.0 is no effect.

image.tooltip: Optional base image to paint over

latent_format.tooltip: Flux1 (16-ch) and Flux2 (128-ch) latents are auto-detected from channel dim under 'flux'. For SD3 (16-ch), SDXL (4-ch), or QwenImage (16-ch), select manually.

degrade_sigma.tooltip: 0 = clean latent. Increase to denoise corrupted latent outputs.

resize_type.tooltip: Select how to resize: by exact dimensions, scale factor, matching another image, etc.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from height while preserving aspect ratio.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from width while preserving aspect ratio.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

multiplier.tooltip: Scale factor (e.g., 2.0 doubles size, 0.5 halves size).

longer_size.tooltip: The longer edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

shorter_size.tooltip: The shorter edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Height auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Width auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

megapixels.tooltip: Target total megapixels (e.g., 1.0 ≈ 1024×1024). Aspect ratio is preserved.

match.tooltip: Resize input to match the dimensions of this reference image or mask.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

multiple.tooltip: Resize so width and height are divisible by this number. Useful for latent alignment (e.g., 8 or 64).

scale_method.tooltip: Interpolation algorithm. 'area' is best for downscaling, 'lanczos' for upscaling, 'nearest-exact' for pixel art.

image_target.tooltip: Image(s) to apply the color transform to.

image_ref.tooltip: Reference image(s) to match colors to.

source_stats.tooltip: per_frame: each frame matched to image_ref individually. uniform: pool stats across all source frames as baseline, match to image_ref. target_frame: use one chosen frame as the baseline for the transform to image_ref, applied uniformly to all frames (preserves relative differences)

target_index.tooltip: Frame index used as the source baseline for computing the transform to image_ref

aspect_ratio.tooltip: The aspect ratio for the output dimensions.

megapixels.tooltip: Target total megapixels. 1.0 MP ≈ 1024x1024 for square.

multiple.tooltip: Nearest multiple of the result to set the selected resolution to.

preview.tooltip: Live preview of the calculated output resolution.

class_name.tooltip: Filter detections by class. Set to 'all' to disable filtering.

max_detections.tooltip: Maximum number of detections to return per image. In order of descending confidence score.

refine_iterations.tooltip: SAM decoder refinement passes (0=use raw detector masks)

individual_masks.tooltip: Output per-object masks instead of union

positive_coords.tooltip: Positive point prompts as JSON [{"x": int, "y": int}, ...] (pixel coords)

negative_coords.tooltip: Negative point prompts as JSON [{"x": int, "y": int}, ...] (pixel coords)

max_objects.tooltip: Max tracked objects. Initial masks count toward this limit. 0 uses the internal cap of 64.

detect_interval.tooltip: Run detection every N frames (1=every frame). Higher values save compute.

initial_mask.tooltip: Mask(s) for the first frame to track (one per object)

conditioning.tooltip: Text conditioning for detecting new objects during tracking

object_indices.tooltip: Comma-separated object indices to include (e.g. '0,2,3'). Empty = all objects.

run_hand_refinement.tooltip: Improves hand pose at the cost of extra inference time and memory use

fov.tooltip: Vertical FoV in degrees. Affects predicted depth and absolute scale. 0 = fall back to ~53° (16:9).

batch_size.tooltip: Max person crops to process as a batch. Larger values use more VRAM for faster inference.

track_data.tooltip: Tracking data from SAM3 Video Track, required for multi-person detection

bboxes.tooltip: Per-frame bounding boxes used for better detection. Can be used as an alternative to tracking data.

strength.tooltip: Global multiplier on all blendshapes. >1 exaggerates.

mouth_strength.tooltip: Multiplier on mouth/jaw shapes. MediaPipe's jawOpen saturates near 1.0.

eye_strength.tooltip: Multiplier on eye shapes. MediaPipe rarely exceeds 0.5; 2-3x often needed.

brow_strength.tooltip: Multiplier on brow/cheek/sneer shapes. MediaPipe outputs ~0.1-0.3; 2-3x.

input_threshold.tooltip: Deadzone on MediaPipe's raw output (below = zero, above = linear remap).

blendshape_smooth_window.tooltip: Gaussian window on MediaPipe's per-frame signal before MHR mapping. MediaPipe's raw output swings 30-70% frame-to-frame on static faces. 1 = disabled. Use odd values.

method.tooltip:
gaussian: symmetric weighted average, best general-purpose smoother.
savgol: sliding polynomial fit, preserves sharp peaks.

rotation_threshold_degrees.tooltip: Disables smoothing for this root rotation rate (degree/frame) to preserve fast spins. 30° suits most content, low values might disable smoothing on ordinary jitter and silently impacts quality. 0 = disable.

pose_data.tooltip: MHR pose data, or external Y-up rig pose data (KimodoSample). All render styles work for external rigs that carry OpenPose joint maps in their _skeleton_override (KimodoSample does).

width.tooltip: Output width in pixels. 0 = use pose data's native image_size. If only one of width/height is set, the other is derived preserving the original aspect.

height.tooltip: Output height in pixels. 0 = use pose data's native image_size. If only one of width/height is set, the other is derived preserving the original aspect.

render_style.tooltip: 'mesh' = 3D MHR mesh rasterized through the camera. 'silhouette' = binary mask of the mesh. 'openpose_2d' = flat 2D skeleton 'openpose_3d' = openpose skeleton as flat-shaded 3D model 'scail' = SCAIL 3D capsules

shader.tooltip: Preset shader. 'normals' = current surface normal in camera space (OpenGL Y+ normal-map convention: +X→R, +Y→G, +Z→B). 'rainbow' = RealisDance style body-Y jet; the 'rainbow_face_*' variants override face verts with normal/per-region colors; 'depth' = linear gray.

rainbow_tilt_z.tooltip: Rotate rainbow jet axis around Z (forward). Differentiates left/right.

rainbow_tilt_x.tooltip: Rotate rainbow jet axis around X (right). Differentiates front/back.

rainbow_tilt_z.tooltip: Rotate rainbow jet axis around Z (forward). Differentiates left/right.

rainbow_tilt_z.tooltip: Rotate rainbow jet axis around Z (forward). Differentiates left/right.

rainbow_tilt_x.tooltip: Rotate rainbow jet axis around X (right). Differentiates front/back.

opacity.tooltip: Mesh alpha over the background image, or over black when none is connected.

person_palette_falloff.tooltip: Per-person desaturation toward white: track k gets a (1 - falloff^k) pastel mix (SCAIL 'softer second person'). 1.0 = off.

region.tooltip: 'hands_only' filters faces via the precomputed `hand_vert_mask` (LBS weights against canonical hand KPs) — isolates the hand mesh for debugging. Falls back to full mesh if the mask is missing.

stick_width_px.tooltip: Body limb ellipse half-width (px). DWPose default = 4.

face_style.tooltip: 'full' = all face landmarks (sapiens-238 if present, else rig-fallback ~30). 'eyes_mouth' = rig-fallback subset (~12 dots: eyes + outer lips only). 'disabled' = no face dots.

hand_style.tooltip: Draw 21+21 hand keypoints + sticks. 'disabled' = no hands. 'dwpose' = solid-blue dots; 'openpose' = rainbow dots.

person_palette_falloff.tooltip: Per-person desaturation: track k blends toward white by 1 - falloff^k. Track 0 stays vivid; 1.0 disables falloff.

radius_m.tooltip: Limb capsule radius in meters (thin = stick-like).

person_palette_falloff.tooltip: Per-person desaturation: track k blends toward white by 1 - falloff^k. Track 0 stays vivid; 1.0 disables falloff.

radius_m.tooltip: Capsule radius in meters (SCAIL reference: ~0.022 m).

hand_style.tooltip: Composite 2D OpenPose hands on top of the 3D capsule body (matches SCAIL — no 3D hand capsules). 'disabled' = no hands. 'dwpose' = solid-blue hand dots; 'openpose' = rainbow dots. Sticks stay rainbow per-finger either way.

face_style.tooltip: 'full' = all face landmarks (sapiens-238 if present, else rig-fallback ~30). 'eyes_mouth' = rig-fallback subset (~12 dots: eyes + outer lips only). 'disabled' = no face dots.

person_palette_falloff.tooltip: Per-person desaturation: track k blends toward white by 1 - falloff^k. Track 0 stays vivid; 1.0 disables falloff.

camera_info.tooltip: Free 6DOF camera override. When wired, the pose is re-projected through this camera (position/target/zoom/rotation/FoV) instead of the predicted one.

format.tooltip: Output format, both fed to Save 3D Model to write to disk. 'glb' = animated GLB (mesh / bones / openpose / scail). 'bvh' = BVH mocap clip (one skeleton; needs the model).

mesh_style.tooltip: 'body_mesh' = real Armature (127 bones, skinning, TRS keyframes, 72 face morphs; needs model). 'bones_only' = bone-shape primitives at each joint (preview armature). 'openpose' = OpenPose-18 3D skeleton from keypoints 'scail' = SCAIL 3D capsule rig (open cylinders capped flush by joint spheres).

bone_vis.tooltip: Bone vis shape, rigidly skinned to each joint.

bone_vis_radius_m.tooltip: Radius in m (sphere radius / octahedron half-width).

bone_vis_color.tooltip: Per-bone vertex colors (unlit material). 'white' = none, 'rainbow_y' = head→toe jet.

shader.tooltip: Bake per-vertex colors matching the Render node's shaders (COLOR_0 + KHR_materials_unlit). 'default' = no colors.

rainbow_tilt_x.tooltip: Rotate rainbow jet axis around X (right). Differentiates front/back.

person_palette_falloff.tooltip: Per-person desaturation: each track gets (1 - falloff^k) pastel mix.

bone_vis.tooltip: Bone vis shape, rigidly skinned to each joint. 'octahedrons' = Blender-style directional bones (joint → primary child).

bone_vis_radius_m.tooltip: Radius in m (sphere radius / octahedron half-width).

bone_vis_color.tooltip: Per-bone vertex colors (unlit material). 'white' = none, 'rainbow_y' = head→toe jet.

stick_radius_m.tooltip: Limb half-width in m. Auto-clamped to bone_length x 0.1.

include_hands.tooltip: Append 21+21 OpenPose hands (wrist + 5 fingers x 4 joints, base→tip) sourced from pred_keypoints_3d.

face_style.tooltip: Face-contour landmarks sampled from pred_vertices at fixed head-mesh vertex IDs (needs canonical_colors on pose_data). 'full' = all ~30 points; 'eyes_mouth' = eyes + outer lips only.

face_marker_radius_m.tooltip: Face dot radius. 0 = auto = 0.3 x marker_radius_m.

stick_radius_m.tooltip: Cylinder radius in m. Bones are open cylinders at constant radius; joint spheres (auto-sized to match) cap the open ends. SCAIL reference = 0.0215 m.

marker_radius_m.tooltip: Joint sphere radius. 0 = auto = stick_radius_m (flush cap).

material_roughness.tooltip: PBR roughness. SCAIL ref = 0.3. 1 = matte; 0 = chrome.

include_hands.tooltip: Append 21+21 hand keypoints + capsule sticks per track.

face_style.tooltip: Face-contour landmarks sampled from pred_vertices (needs canonical_colors on pose_data). 'full' = all ~30 points; 'eyes_mouth' = eyes + outer lips only.

bone_smooth_window.tooltip: Gaussian smoothing window on per-bone rotation keyframes / keypoint tracks. 0 = off. 7-15 calms spins/jitter where upstream Smooth misses spikes.

units.tooltip: BVH OFFSET/position units. 'cm' is the mocap standard.

camera_translation.tooltip: Bake pred_cam_t into the root's translation 'off' = bind position 'centered' = delta from frame 0 'absolute' = raw (Z is camera depth — usually meters away).

angle_x.tooltip: Rotation around the X axis in degrees.

angle_y.tooltip: Rotation around the Y axis in degrees.

angle_z.tooltip: Rotation around the Z axis in degrees.

model_3d.tooltip: 3D model file from an upstream 3D node.

width.tooltip: Render width of the viewport in pixels.

height.tooltip: Render height of the viewport in pixels.

model_3d_info.tooltip: Placement of each model in the scene: position, rotation, and scale (Y-up world space).

camera_info.tooltip: Viewport camera information: position, look-at target, zoom, and type.

pose_start.tooltip: Start step of the pose conditioning.

pose_end.tooltip: End step of the pose conditioning.

video_frame_offset.tooltip: Cumulative output frame this chunk begins at. Wire from the previous chunk's video_frame_offset output.

previous_frame_count.tooltip: Tail frames of previous_frames to anchor. SCAIL-2 trained at 5 (81-frame chunks, 76-frame step).

pose_video.tooltip: Video used for pose conditioning. Will be downscaled to half the resolution of the main video.

pose_video_mask.tooltip: SCAIL-2 only. Colored per-identity SAM3 mask video at the same resolution as pose_video.

replacement_mode.tooltip: SCAIL-2 only. False = Animation Mode (pose_video_mask should have black background). True = Replacement Mode (pose_video_mask should have white background).

reference_image.tooltip: Reference image. The first image is the primary reference (composite all identities onto it). SCAIL-2: extra batch images are used as additional views (back view, close-up, occluded background), each needing a matching reference_image_mask in that identity's color.

reference_image_mask.tooltip: SCAIL-2 only. Colored reference mask, batch matching reference_image (first = primary reference mask, rest = identity masks for the additional reference_image).

clip_vision_output.tooltip: CLIP vision features for conditioning. Model is trained with stretch resize to aspect ratio.

previous_frames.tooltip: SCAIL-2 only. Full decoded output of the previous chunk. Only the last previous_frame_count are used as the extension anchor.

driving_track_data.tooltip: SAM3 track of the driving pose video. Will be rendered into the pose_video_mask output.

object_indices.tooltip: Comma-separated list of person indices to include (e.g. '0,2,3'). Applied to both reference and pose video masks. Empty = all.

sort_by.tooltip: Order in which palette colors are assigned to the tracked objects (applied to both reference and pose video so each identity keeps the same color). replacement_mode.tooltip: False = Animation Mode (pose_video_mask has black background, reference_image_mask has white background). True = Replacement Mode (pose_video_mask has white background, reference_image_mask has black background).

ref_track_data.tooltip: SAM3 track of the reference image(s) (one identity per object, colored in batch order), or a plain MASK of the reference subject (rendered as a single identity).

bboxes.tooltip: Optional bounding boxes for more accurate detections. Required for multi-person detection.

scale.tooltip: Multiplier for the bounding box area around each detected face.

force_square.tooltip: Expand the shorter bbox axis so the crop region is always square.

output_width.tooltip: Width each crop is resized to.

output_height.tooltip: Height each crop is resized to.

padding.tooltip: Extra padding in pixels added on each side of the bbox before cropping.

keep_aspect.tooltip: Whether to stretch the crop to fit the output size, or pad with black pixels to preserve aspect ratio.

original_resized_images.tooltip: The original resized image before pre-processing, used as reference.

color_correction_method.tooltip: Method to match the generated image colors to the original image. lab: transfer color in CIELAB space, preserving detail (most faithful). wavelet: transfer low-frequency color, keeping upscaled high-frequency detail. adain: match per-channel mean/std (fastest, global tint). none: skip color transfer (geometry alignment only).

latent.tooltip: The VAE-encoded SeedVR2 latent to split.

temporal_overlap.tooltip: Latent frames shared between adjacent chunks and crossfaded at merge; 0 = no overlap.

chunking_mode.tooltip: manual = use frames_per_chunk exactly; auto = predict the largest chunk that fits free VRAM.

latents.tooltip: The sampled temporal chunks in sequence order.

temporal_overlap.tooltip: The temporal_overlap output of Split SeedVR2 Latent. 0 = plain concatenation.

selection.tooltip: Method used to choose key blocks for full token-level attention. sol-attn: Sparsifying Online Attention uses a training-free adaptive threshold for each attention head and query block. sla: Sparse-Linear Attention keeps a fixed percentage of the highest-scoring key blocks; use only with model weights trained for this pattern. vsa: Video Sparse Attention (FastVideo) uses 3D video-cube tiling and a learned coarse attention branch; requires FastH3 model weights.

tau.tooltip: Threshold in score-distribution sigmas. Higher is sparser: 1.0 keeps ~16% of key blocks exact, 1.5 ~7%, 2.0 ~2.7%.

keep_percent.tooltip: Percent of key blocks each query block keeps exactly (sinks and the diagonal ride on top). The selection SLA-style LoRAs are distilled against; without such a LoRA higher is closer to dense.
Percent of video cubes each query cube keeps; FastH3-VSA checkpoints are trained at 10. Uses the model's to_gate_compress layers for the coarse branch when present.

start_percent.tooltip: Percentage point when sparse attention begins. Before this point, attention stays dense.

end_percent.tooltip: Percentage point when sparse attention ends. After this point, attention returns to dense.

dense_blocks.tooltip: Transformer blocks that always run dense, e.g. '0, 1, 47-49'.

min_tokens.tooltip: Sequences shorter than this stay dense.

extra_tokens.tooltip: Extra top-scoring tokens each query block attends beyond its selected blocks. Closer to dense for more attention time; 256 recommended, 0 disables. Ignored for VSA.

sink_conditioning.tooltip: MiniMax-H3 only. exact_kv: every query attends the packed text/audio/reference rows exactly (~3% cost). exact_kv_and_rows: additionally runs the target-audio query rows dense (keeps generated audio intact).

verbose.tooltip: Logs whether each attention shape used sparse attention or why it stayed dense.

dotall.tooltip: When enabled, the dot (.) character will match any character including newline characters. When disabled, dots won't match newlines.

count.tooltip: Maximum number of replacements to make. Set to 0 to replace all occurrences (default). Set to 1 to replace only the first match, 2 for the first two matches, etc.

indent.tooltip: Spaces per indent level. 0 produces compact single-line string.

font_size.tooltip: Font size as a percentage of the image height.

outline.tooltip: Draw a black outline around the text.

video.tooltip: Video frames as image batch. Assumed to be 24 FPS; subsampled to 1 FPS internally.

thinking.tooltip: Operate in thinking mode if the model supports it.

quantized_backward.tooltip: When using training_dtype 'none' and training on quantized model, doing backward with quantized matmul when enabled.

offloading.tooltip: Offload model weights to CPU during training to save GPU memory.

existing_lora.tooltip: The existing LoRA to append to. Set to None for new LoRA.

bucket_mode.tooltip: Enable resolution bucket mode. When enabled, expects pre-bucketed latents from ResolutionBucket node.

bypass_mode.tooltip: Enable bypass mode for training. When enabled, adapters are applied via forward hooks instead of weight modification. Useful for quantized models where weights cannot be directly modified.

lora.tooltip: The LoRA model to apply to the diffusion model.

strength_model.tooltip: How strongly to modify the diffusion model. This value can be negative.

bypass.tooltip: When enabled, applies LoRA in bypass mode without modifying base model weights. Useful for training and when model weights are offloaded.

lora.tooltip: The LoRA model to save. Do not use the model with LoRA layers.

prefix.tooltip: The prefix to use for the saved LoRA file.

steps.tooltip: Optional: The number of steps the LoRA has been trained for, used to name the saved file.

image.tooltip: Preprocessed image from ImageCropToMask (pad_factor=1.0 for TRELLIS.2).

clip_vision_model.tooltip: DINOv3 ViT-L/16 ClipVision with bundled NAF weights.

fov.tooltip: Horizontal FOV in degrees of the views as framed: 20 for rig renders and most multi-view generators, or MoGeGeometryToFOV on one of the views for photos.

front.tooltip: Square view of the object's front side, with alpha or on a black background, framed like the rig: the object spans about 1/1.1 of the frame at its widest, the same scale in every view. The first connected view (front, left, back, right order) is the front the mesh is posed to.

left.tooltip: Square view of the object's left side, with alpha or on a black background, framed like the rig: the object spans about 1/1.1 of the frame at its widest, the same scale in every view. The first connected view (front, left, back, right order) is the front the mesh is posed to.

back.tooltip: Square view of the object's back side, with alpha or on a black background, framed like the rig: the object spans about 1/1.1 of the frame at its widest, the same scale in every view. The first connected view (front, left, back, right order) is the front the mesh is posed to.

right.tooltip: Square view of the object's right side, with alpha or on a black background, framed like the rig: the object spans about 1/1.1 of the frame at its widest, the same scale in every view. The first connected view (front, left, back, right order) is the front the mesh is posed to.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent images in the batch.

shape_subdivides.tooltip: Shape information used to guide higher-detail reconstruction during decoding. Helps preserve structure consistency at higher resolutions.

shape_latent.tooltip: The 512-resolution shape latent output from the first shape-stage KSampler.

target_resolution.tooltip: Voxel resolution of the upsampled shape. Higher = more detail, more VRAM.

erode_radius.tooltip: Erode the alpha matte by this pixel radius before cropping (avoids border bleed).

size.tooltip: Square image size. The model is trained at 1024; other sizes run but are off-distribution.

num_gaussians.tooltip: Number of gaussians to produce (rounded to a multiple of 32). 262144 matches the octree's point density; higher oversamples the same points (denser, but no new detail) and costs proportionally more VRAM/time.

seed.tooltip: Seeds the octree point sampler (global RNG) for deterministic decodes.

octree_level.tooltip: Octree depth for the preview decode (lower = cheaper/coarser).

num_gaussians.tooltip: Number of gaussians to produce for the preview (rounded to a multiple of 32).

point_size.tooltip: Maximum splat radius in pixels. Each gaussian is sized from its scale and capped here; lower = finer/pointier, higher = chunkier.

images.tooltip: RGBA images are saved with their alpha channel as transparency (vp9 codec only).

crf.tooltip: Higher crf means lower quality with a smaller file size, lower crf means higher quality higher filesize.

dilate_width.tooltip: Dilation radius for the primary mask region (0 = no dilation)

quadmask.tooltip: Preprocessed quadmask from VOIDQuadmaskPreprocess [T, H, W]

length.tooltip: Number of pixel frames to process. For CogVideoX-Fun-V1.5 (patch_size_t=2), latent_t must be even — lengths that produce odd latent_t are rounded down (e.g. 49 → 45).

video_frame_offset.tooltip: The amount of frames to seek in all the input videos. Used for generating longer videos by chunk. Connect to the video_frame_offset output of the previous node for extending a video.

batch_size.tooltip: Number of videos to generate simultaneously.

video_frame_offset.tooltip: Frames to seek into the pose video. Connect to the video_frame_offset output of the previous node when extending.

pose_strength.tooltip: Scales the pose video's influence on the motion. 1.0 is the trained behavior; below weakens adherence, above amplifies. 0.0 mutes it but does not fully remove it.

pose_start_percent.tooltip: Sampling percent at which the pose influence starts. Outside the window the pose branch is skipped entirely, which also speeds those steps up.

pose_end_percent.tooltip: Sampling percent at which the pose influence ends. Motion is mostly established early, so e.g. 0.7 can loosen fine detail while keeping the choreography.

reference_image_strength.tooltip: Scales how strongly generated frames attend to the reference image's latent frame. Below 1.0 loosens identity/appearance adherence (e.g. to let the prompt restyle), above tightens it against drift.

pose_video.tooltip: The video whose motion is transferred to the reference character.

clip_vision_output.tooltip: CLIP vision of the reference image.

positive_pose.tooltip: Prompt for the pose-video branch, describing the motion rather than the character. Defaults to positive. Used for both the cond and uncond passes.

clip_vision_output_pose.tooltip: CLIP vision of the pose video's first frame. Defaults to clip_vision_output.

continue_motion.tooltip: Previous motion sequence to continue from for temporal consistency.

device.tooltip: Where to keep the cache. cpu (RAM) is the safe choice, the cache will not fit in VRAM alongside the model at typical sizes. gpu (VRAM) can be faster if it fits.

dtype.tooltip: Storage precision. default stores the activations in the model's compute dtype. int8 halves the cache, int4 quarters it, convrot is used to retain accuracy.

mask_1.tooltip: Mask for the first speaker, required if using two audio inputs.

mask_2.tooltip: Mask for the second speaker, required if using two audio inputs.

motion_frame_count.tooltip: Number of previous frames to use as motion context.

length.tooltip: The number of frames in the generated video. Should stay 149 for WanDancer.

clip_vision_output.tooltip: The CLIP vision embeds for the first frame.

clip_vision_output_ref.tooltip: The CLIP vision embeds for the reference image.

start_image.tooltip: The initial image(s) to be encoded, can be any number of frames.

mask.tooltip: Image conditioning mask for the start image(s). White is kept, black is generated. Used for the local generations.

audio_inject_scale.tooltip: The scale for the audio features when injected into the video model.

segment_index.tooltip: Which segment this is (0 for first, 1 for second, etc.)

audio.tooltip: Audio to calculate total output frames from and extract segment audio.

num_segments.tooltip: How many padded segments to emit as lists.

audio.tooltip: Audio to slice for each emitted segment.

start_x.tooltip: Normalized X coordinate (0-1) for start position.

start_y.tooltip: Normalized Y coordinate (0-1) for start position.

end_x.tooltip: Normalized X coordinate (0-1) for end position.

end_y.tooltip: Normalized Y coordinate (0-1) for end position.

track_spread.tooltip: Normalized distance between tracks. Tracks are spread perpendicular to the motion direction.

bezier.tooltip: Enable Bezier curve path using the mid point as control point.

mid_x.tooltip: Normalized X control point for Bezier curve. Only used when 'bezier' is enabled.

mid_y.tooltip: Normalized Y control point for Bezier curve. Only used when 'bezier' is enabled.

interpolation.tooltip: Controls the timing/speed of movement along the path.

track_mask.tooltip: Optional mask to indicate visible frames.
